title: Slack

web_hook.description: Webhook to post a message to Slack

title.description: Title of the message to send to Slack

attachment.description: A file path & name to attach to the message. Supports a single file or a list of files. Must be supported by the specific notification type.

guidance:
> Added **v0.5**

Send a Slack notification - such as to alert someone when a recipe is finished or if it fails.

See [docs](https://slack.com/apps/new/A0F7XDUAZ-incoming-webhooks) for how to create a WebHook in Slack.

### Run
### Recipe
```yaml
run:
  on_success:
    - notification.slack:
        web_hook: Slack WebHook
        title: title
        message: message
```

### Function
```python
from wrangles.connectors.notification import slack
slack.run(
    web_hook= 'Slack WebHook',
    title='title',
    message='message'
)
```
